title: The 'ABC' of split-nanoluciferase HIF heterodimerization bioassays: Applications, Benefits & Considerations.
authors: Janssens, Liesl K; Stove, Christophe P
one_liner_zh: 该文利用细胞分裂型纳米荧光素酶生物测定法研究HIF异二聚化，属于湿实验药理学表征，无AI或物理模拟方法，且未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Hypoxia-inducible factors (HIF) are interesting targets for multiple therapeutic indications. While HIF activation is desired for the treatment of anemia-related and ischemic diseases, HIF inhibition is of tremendous interest to anti-cancer drug development. Different signaling events within the HIF pathway are being targeted by drug discovery programs, with a special interest in HIF-selective (possibly also HIF1/2 isoform-selective) compounds. In this study, we applied recently developed cell-based split-nanoluciferase HIF heterodimerization assays to study the effects of compounds, targeting HIF activity by various mechanisms of action. This study shows that the application of similar or diverse assay protocols allows to detect various influences on HIF heterodimerization as a key signaling event in the oxygen sensing pathway: increased HIF heterodimerization (roxadustat, MG-132), decreased HIF heterodimerization (PX-478, ibuprofen) and direct (HIF isoform-selective) heterodimerization inhibiting effects (PT-2385). Changes in treatment time and in the assay protocol allowed to assess direct and indirect effects on HIFalpha-HIFbeta heterodimerization. In addition to the evaluation of applications of these new bioassays regarding pharmacological characterizations, benefits and considerations are discussed related to the use of cellular, luminescent-based bioassays. Briefly, benefits include the bidirectional nature of the biological readout, the upstream mechanism of detection, the differentiation between HIF1 and HIF2 effects and the simulation of various conditions. Specific and general considerations include cell-based, technical and disease/drug-related aspects (e.g., non-specific effects, color interference). In summary, the versatility of these bioassays offers benefits in widespread applications regarding drug discovery and pharmacological characterization of various therapeutics, applying either the same or optimized experimental protocols.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子（HIF）是多种治疗适应症中引人关注的靶点。虽然HIF激活对于治疗贫血相关疾病和缺血性疾病是可取的，但HIF抑制对抗癌药物开发具有巨大意义。HIF通路内的不同信号事件正被药物发现项目所靶向，其中对HIF选择性（可能还包括HIF1/2亚型选择性）化合物特别感兴趣。在本研究中，我们应用了最近开发的基于细胞的分裂纳米荧光素酶HIF异二聚化检测方法，以研究通过不同作用机制靶向HIF活性的化合物的效应。本研究显示，应用相似或多样化的检测方案能够检测到对HIF异二聚化（作为氧感应通路中的关键信号事件）的各种影响：HIF异二聚化增加（roxadustat、MG-132）、HIF异二聚化减少（PX-478、ibuprofen）以及直接（HIF亚型选择性）异二聚化抑制效应（PT-2385）。处理时间和检测方案的变化允许评估对HIFalpha-HIFbeta异二聚化的直接和间接效应。除了评估这些新型生物检测在药理学表征方面的应用外，还讨论了与使用基于细胞、发光型生物检测相关的优势和考虑因素。简而言之，优势包括生物读数的双向性质、检测的上游机制、HIF1与HIF2效应的区分以及多种条件的模拟。具体和一般性考虑包括基于细胞的、技术性的以及疾病/药物相关的方面（例如，非特异性效应、颜色干扰）。总之，这些生物检测的多功能性在药物发现和各种治疗药物的药理学表征中提供了广泛应用的益处，无论是采用相同还是优化的实验方案。
